row.answer: Hero's Entrance targets an allied champion and fixes Galio's landing spot at that ally's position when cast. It refreshes his passive magic shield and grants it to allied champions in the area. After a delay, he lands with area magic damage and displacement; his channel is vulnerable to crowd control early, before he becomes crowd-control immune and untargetable.
row.counterplay: Move away from the initial landing location and try to interrupt his channel early if he is within reach.
